mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX 20d returns are positive in < 40% of instances

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that increases the risk of recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) signals stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as real interest rates rise and growth slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 260 and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by HOUST > 1500 and UNRATE < 6.5%), the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative due to overvaluation and increased risk of policy tightening.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 AND UNRATE < 6.5% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as growth concerns dominate.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 106.0 and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as low interest rates support equity valuations over a longer horizon.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX 60d returns are positive in < 40% of instances

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the housing sector is a key component of the economy.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 142000 thousand persons signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors react to deteriorating employment data.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 142000 and SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances
